scope: Retrospective initial-belief-only opportunity diagnostic; not historical dynamic-policy replay or fresh efficacy
prior: Uniform over unique initial extensions, no regenerated proposals or held-out rules
observation_model: Exact deterministic membership conditional on a persistent sampled initial rule
target_loss: Mean Brier over every integer 0..100, including queried integers; equal fixed weights
tie_break: Smallest integer query among exactly equal rational values
computation: Exact Fraction dynamic programming; optimize every contingent future query, no greedy tail in h2/h3
gate: All 32 initial supports valid; >=5% aggregate successive full-budget gains for h1->h2 and h2->h3
null_action: Bank full panel and do not select favorable seeds, change weights, or import future hypotheses to rescue this diagnostic
